references.text: The description of the courtyard hangings of fine twisted linen is given first in Moses' instructions regarding the tabernacle.
Repeats the dimensions and materials for the courtyard hangings, including fine twisted linen.
Earlier in the same chapter, the beginning of the construction of the courtyard hangings of fine twisted linen is described.
Fine twisted linen is also used in the priests' garments, showing the holy significance of the material.
Describes the pillars and fittings that support the hangings mentioned in 38:16.
Lists the structural elements (pillars) to which the hangings in 38:16 are attached.
